Messages.Author: Potato
Messages.Body:
Kindred Coercion [DS]
Cardtype: Reaction
Cost: X blood
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable during a <referendum>. This reacting vampire may cancel
the votes of X minions. The affected minions cannot be older than the
reacting <vampire>. (S) As above, but you may change the votes of the
affected minions to votes of your choice.

Can a vampire I control use this card on themselves (during an
opponents referendum)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sure.
